description_en: Queries the configurations of API security log subscription
description_zh: 查询API安全日志订阅列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-log-deliveries --instance-id waf_v3_public_cn-uqm2z00000a --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApisecLogDeliveries

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

DeliveryConfigs.description_en: The configurations of API security log subscription

AssertKey.description_en:
The type of the log subscription. Valid values:

risk: risk information.

event: attack event information.

asset: asset information
AssertKey.description_zh:
日志订阅类型。取值：

risk：表示风险信息。
event：表示攻击事件信息。
asset：表示资产信息

LogRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where logs are stored

LogStoreName.description_en: The name of the Logstore in Simple Log Service
LogStoreName.description_zh: 日志服务SLS日志库LogStore的名称

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the project in Simple Log Service

Status.description_en:
The status of API security log subscription. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled
Status.description_zh:
API安全日志订阅开启状态。取值：

true：表示开启。

false：表示关闭
